integrity: The proof is self-contained, the exact-cyclotomic checker supplements but does not replace it, and the originality comparison is evidence-limited.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four equal-modulus coefficients on an affinely independent four-point support over odd-prime vector spaces; no arbitrary coefficients or rank-two supports. An older equivalent phase-code theorem may exist.
title: Three-stratum phase-only Fourier-zero rigidity for affine four-point simplices
